verdicts.reason: Cancellation validation no longer accepts the UUIDT IDs issued by the invocation store, and the tests covering that contract were removed.

findings.message: The UUID validator rejects invocation IDs issued as UUIDTs, causing cancellation by those IDs to return 400 before reaching cancelJobs. Preserve the shape-only validation required by the invocation ID contract.
findings.evidence: Changed `.array(z.string().refine((id) => UUID.validateString(id, false), idsMessage))` to `.array(z.string().uuid(idsMessage))`. The removed comment states that invocation IDs are UUIDTs whose version and variant nibbles carry counters and random bytes, so version-aware validation rejects real IDs. The removed test expected 200 for `[new UUIDT().toString(), new UUIDT().toString()]` and asserted those IDs reached `mockCancelJobs`.

findings.message: Assertions were removed or rewritten; equivalent replacement coverage has not been established.
